limits: Smooth parallel-sheet dielectric only; angular legacy glass uses an explicit IOR=1.5 approximation. RGB tint is aggregate transmission, not spectral layer absorption.
Thin-sheet BDPT explicitly rejected; rough sheets and full closure/group execution remain pending.
Coverage bakes support common top-level graphs; view-dependent emissive portal retains diagnosed 2% coverage approximation.
Native repeated mask UV is preserved for eligible UV graphs; generated/object coordinate graphs still use smart-project. Normal/displacement and mip/ray footprint filters remain pending.
Barcelona still retains only 512/20,622 particle instances; this iteration does not implement BLAS/TLAS.
Times include checkpoint output and concurrent unrelated workloads; import, CPU BVH build and GPU preparation are excluded. These are observations, not speed or convergence rankings.
Images come from SceneRenderer Metal PT. Blender is used only to read/bake assets. OIDN previews do not establish unbiased transport accuracy.
